dialogDescription: Getting started and downloading the models
welcomeTagline: Transcribe your meetings live, with Catalan at the heart.

live.title: See the text as you talk
live.text: Murmur transcribes the meeting in real time, with full support for Catalan. You can follow it, correct it and annotate it as it happens.

speakers.title: Who's talking and what you jot down
speakers.text: It tells voices apart and shows you who spoke and for how long. The notes you write are tied to the exact minute of the meeting.

cover.title: The meeting, summed up
cover.text: When it ends, Murmur prepares a summary with the title, main points, decisions and tasks. Each point links to the moment it was said.

indicator.title: The call, always in view
indicator.text: While you record, a small bar sits on the edge of the screen, over the call. One click captures what's being shared, and the screenshot shows up in the summary, at the minute it was taken.

alerts.title: Never miss recording a meeting
alerts.text: When Zoom, Meet or Teams use the microphone, Murmur lets you know from the menu bar. One click and it starts recording.

demo.liveText: So if everyone's happy with it, we'll finalize the budget on Thursday and send it on Friday
demo.livePartial: to the client so they can

models.introReady: You can now record your first meeting.
models.introDownloading: The download continues even if you close this window.
models.introChoose: Murmur works with models that run on this Mac. You only need to download them once.
models.transcriptionText: Turns speech into text, in Catalan and other languages, right on this Mac.
models.languageQuestion: Which language are your meetings mostly in?
models.whisperTextCa: When the meeting ends, the BSC's Catalan Whisper listens to it again and rewrites the text, cleaner. All on this computer.
models.whisperText: When the meeting ends, Whisper listens to it again and rewrites the text, with punctuation and capitals. All on this computer.
models.whisperMixed: Not yet for meetings in two languages: Whisper would turn the Spanish into Catalan. We're working on it.
models.offline: Once downloaded, they work offline. Meeting audio and text never leave this computer.
models.summaryText: Title, summary, decisions and tasks for each meeting. Choose where they're written:
models.localText: Gemma 4, by Google, runs on this Mac. It takes {{size}} and needs a Mac with 16 GB of memory.
models.noneText: You can choose later in Settings › Intelligence.

cloudTexts.anthropic: Only the meeting's text is sent to {{name}}, never the audio. You need an API key, billed separately by usage: the subscription doesn't work.
cloudTexts.openai: Only the meeting's text is sent to {{name}}, never the audio. You need an API key, billed separately by usage: the subscription doesn't work.
cloudTexts.gemini: Only the meeting's text is sent to {{name}}, never the audio. You need an API key, which has a free tier with limits: the subscription doesn't work.
cloudTexts.openrouter: Only the meeting's text is sent to {{name}}, which passes it on to the company behind the model you choose, never the audio. You need an API key with prepaid credit.

models.cloudConnected: {{name}} connected. Key saved in the keychain, ending in …{{hint}}
models.offlineCloud: Audio never leaves this computer. For the summaries, only the meeting's text is sent, with your key.
models.analytics: Send anonymous usage statistics: which features are used, with nothing of what's said in your meetings. You can change it in Settings › General.

voice.title: Let Murmur recognize you
voice.intro: Murmur can save a print of your voice to recognize you automatically in every meeting. To do it, read this sentence out loud.
voice.sentence: Good morning. I'm the voice Murmur needs to learn to recognize in meetings, whether we're in the room or on a call.
voice.ready: Press the button and read the sentence.
voice.privacy: Murmur doesn't keep the recording, only a print of your voice (biometric data). It stays on this computer, never leaves it, and you can delete it in Settings › Transcription.
